notes: Inputs listed in figure label order left to right: 'Vin-' (net vinn, gate of M102) then 'Vin+' (net vinp, gate of M101); which is inverting is left to the pipeline.
No ground symbol in Fig. 6; rails are VDD and VSS, so pins.gnd = vss.
M101/M102 have a bulk wire drawn to their common source (tail) node, recorded as Body=tail; other devices have no separate bulk wire.
M105 gate is tied (dot) to its own drain (net pg) and to the M106 gate: self-biased PMOS mirror loading the folded cascode.

The horizontal net o1 (M106/M107 drains) runs through the gate plates of M200 and Mf and ends at a dot on the Mc1 drain / Ma drain node, so the FBS (common-gate Ma) feeds back into the first-stage output, consistent with the text.
o1 crosses the M203 drain wire without a dot: not connected.
Ma drawn with source arrow pointing out at the bottom (NMOS, text: 'common-gate amplifier with an nMOS transistor Ma'); source = nx (Ca/Mc2 node), drain = o1.
Cm connects the M202/M203 drain node (n2, gate of M301) to Out; Ca connects Out to nx.
Process per text: commercial 0.8-um CMOS, Vtn = 0.85 V, Vtp = -0.78 V.
